topic: What is an API? (explained without the jargon)
hook: Your booking system talks to your payment system. An API is how.
caption:
Your booking system talks to your payment system. An API is how.

API stands for Application Programming Interface, which explains nothing. So here is the plain version.

An API is an agreed way for two systems to talk. One system sends a request in a format both sides understand. The other sends back an answer in the same format.

Think of a restaurant. You don't walk into the kitchen to cook your own food. You tell the waiter what you want, the waiter takes the order to the kitchen and brings your meal back. The waiter is the API.

You already use APIs every day: paying by card on a website, logging in with Google, seeing a map on a contact page.

Save this for the next time a developer says 'API'.
